title: Chronological and spatial trends in pottery use revealed through lipid residue analyses of LBK pottery vessels
version: Ludwinowo, site 7: Neolithic settlement in Kuyavia, chapter 9, DOI 10.33547/ODA-SAH.08.Lud.09.
lineage: Site-specific organic-residue analysis. Reuses Salque et al. 2013 measurements for sieves and adds new analyses mostly from other vessel forms; distinct evidence stream from the bones.

passages.note: Places dairy-bearing perforated vessels at Ludwinowo in LBK phases IIB and III.
